passages.text:
Re: Looking for a PoC
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Friday, August 19, 2022 at 1:02:10PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Adam Kaplan
Cc: [contact omitted] Amy Noreuil, [contact omitted] Brittany Brown, [contact omitted] Johnny Walsh,
[contact omitted] OTI Sudan Field, [contact omitted] OTI Sudan mail list
Awesome. I didn't do anything -all of your good doing!!
On Fri, Aug 19, 2022 at 1:01 PM Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Vera,
Good news, from our Sudan team.
Just an update on this - the facebook post was thankfully taken down! It's unclear who took it down, but we know
that it was under review by facebook. It continued to get relatively low traction and no one from the team was
relocated as the staff.
Thankyou for your help.
A
Adam Kaplan
Senior Media Advisor
USAID/Office of Transition Initiatives
On Tue, Aug 16, 2022 at 6:49 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Let's wait to see what happens
On Tue, Aug 16, 2022 at 6:33 PM Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Not sure at this point, all 1 know is what Mike reported per FB awareness. First step it seems to me. If escalation
gets us faster or more energetic efforts by FB, yes please.
The OTI team on the ground is investigating too.
A
On Tue, Aug 16, 2022 at 6:19 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Ok so no escalation from is necessary?
This is just one of the examples why we need these issues elevated.
On Tue, Aug 16, 2022 at 5:46 PM Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sudan colleagues,
Facebook is aware and looking into it. Please let us know if there is anything else that presents a similar or
related threat.
Best
A
Adam Kaplan
Senior Media Advisor
USAID/Office of Transition Initiatives

-- Forwarded message ---
From: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Date: Tue, Aug 16, 2022 at 5:36 PM
Subject: Re: Looking for a PoC
To: Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Amy Noreuil <[contact omitted]>
Hi Adam,
Great to hear from you. I know our Sudan team was alerted to this post earlier in the day - my
understanding is that it's under review. Let us know if there's any other content you all are tracking on this.
Mike
From: Adam Kaplan <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, August 16, 2022 5:15 PM
To: Mike Bradow < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Amy Noreuil <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Looking for a PoC
This Message Is From an External Sender
Mike,
Hope you are well, and sorry for reaching out, out of the blue.
I am wondering if you can help us connect with the relevant folks to report an issue we are having in Sudan.
38 of OTI's Sudan implementer staff were just dangerously doxed on Facebook as working for the "CIA
subsidiary" Chemonics.
Our team on the ground is looking into the organization that posted the names, nothing concrete, but it seems
they suspect it is a Russian front.
Thank you in advance for any assistance or connection you can provide.
Sincerely
Adam
Adam Kaplan
Senior Media Advisor
USAID/Office of Transition Initiatives
Vera Zakem
Senior Technology and Policy Advisor
USAID
